name: Absurd Action Comedy
description: Everyday problems become extravagant action scenes. Wit, caution and negotiation remain useful.
tone: Playful, cinematic and absurd, with clear physical situations beneath the jokes.
dramaticRhythm: Escalating physical commotion, sharp reversals and brief ordinary recovery. At least one concrete comic disruption must materially change each interactive scene.
surprisePolicy: Make established people, objects and intentions collide in an unexpected but legible way. The absurdity must happen in the world, not merely appear as a witty comparison.
consequenceStyle: Failed stunts change the predicament. Jokes do not erase losses, commitments or the selected intention.
choiceGuidance: Support direct action, clever de-escalation and investigation where plausible. Do not force participation in the spectacle.

tasks.opening: Anchor the player, then introduce a visible physical absurdity or social fiasco that demands no destiny but cannot be mistaken for ordinary administration.
tasks.continuation: Resolve the chosen approach, make its consequences physically or socially concrete, then develop a new comic complication rather than returning to routine choices.
